note: RASAero .CDX1 files now fly at the launch weight and CG their author measured, instead of a fabricated 2 mm-wall mass. CHANGES NUMBERS on nearly every .CDX1: across a 48-file corpus the median design was importing at 18 % of its own stated loaded weight (the worst at 5 %), which made nose-heavy real rockets come out statically unstable here and is the actual reason many RASAero imports aborted mid-flight. The stated figures are applied as stage overrides with the motor backed out, exactly as desktop OpenRocket does, with the per-stage arithmetic shown in the file's own pounds and inches; RASAero's cumulative stack weights are inverted the way desktop inverts them, and on the one design that exists in both formats the result lands within 0.1 % of what its RockSim twin states independently. 43 of 48 corpus files now apply; the other five state no weight at all. Also: saving a staged design as .CDX1 and reopening it no longer inflates its mass on every round trip. Known limits stated in the changelog: an overridden stage ignores mass you add to it (including the Measured mass & CG box) until the override is cleared, and rotational inertia is still computed from the geometry.
